description: Snap a Node3D position to a grid in local or global space. Useful for modular level building and keeping 3D scenes aligned.

axes.description: Axes to snap. Any of: ["x"], ["x","z"], ["x","y","z"] (default: all axes)

grid_size.description: Positive grid size. Use a number for uniform snapping or {x,y,z} for per-axis snapping.

node_path.description: Path to the Node3D to snap

name: snap_node_to_grid
